content.text: Independence is the cessation of a vassal-liege relationship. It may refer to:

items.text: Grant independence action by the liege.
A faction demanding independence and the resulting war

content.text: A vassal can achieve independence without taking hostile actions against the liege by:

items.text: Inheriting an independent title which is higher ranked than his current primary title (even if the new rank is lower than that of the liege) OR

Obtaining a title which is of the same rank (or higher) as the liege's primary title via conquest. An example is in the "Stamford Bridge" bookmark: should William successfully conquer England, he'll be independent of France.
